sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Small Christmas gift (Gift) is a pickupable Event Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A small neatly wrapped Christmas gift. Looks like Santa is kind to you. Come on, open it up!

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can only be opened outside of a raid
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
- Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - This item was first added as part of Escape from Tarkov's 2023 Christmas celebration.
